name: Áed Sláine
text: Áed Sláine was a king of Tara near the year 600, named in many genealogies. Legend records his mother Mugain Mór, a territorial goddess of Munster, as birthing a trout before his own birth. MacKillop reads the form as a Tara high king with a wondrous birthmark. The principal record sits under the Tara headword.

attributes.attribute: Tara high king c. 600; son of the territorial goddess Mugain Mór

okr.objective: Áed Sláine is a MacKillop signpost to Tara.
key_results: Cites Tara as the canonical headword.
Mother Mugain Mór was a Munster territorial goddess.
